topology_edges.conditional_mechanism: The Core CPI Reference is an input to the CPI Change Calculation.

The Observed CPI Change is classified as the target metric.

target_bridge.mechanism: Map only currently supported paths into the current target period and exact metric.
target_bridge.magnitude_requirement: Current numerical evidence must support the relevant option boundary, not only the direction of change.
target_bridge.failure_signal: The current baseline, target timing, or magnitude evidence does not support the proposed boundary crossing.

worked_procedure: Lock the exact current target operation and baseline.
Fill the preserved factor nodes with current evidence.

Compare supported paths with current factors outside the graph.
